payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the interfaces currently implemented for Macaw.

claims.text: Macaw has implemented three interfaces: File IO, Standard IO, and Telegram.
The Standard IO interface is an interactive command line interface for development purposes.
The Telegram interface allows multi-modal interactions and is designed for real user interaction.
Macaw supports a potential Natural Language Interface for accessing structured data in future releases.
Macaw is designed for multi-turn, multi-modal, and mixed-initiative interactions.
